title: Signal Garden — Bioluminescent Ecosystem Synth

checks.name: Inline JavaScript syntax

checks.name: Deterministic seeded generator
checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/)[1],r=s.match(/function mulberry32\\(a\\) \\{[\\s\\S]*?\\n    \\}/)[0],m=new Function(r+';return mulberry32')(),a=m(40731),b=m(40731);if(Array.from({length:20},()=>a()).join()!=Array.from({length:20},()=>b()).join())process.exit(1);console.log('PASS: identical seed sequences match')"
checks.details: Extracted the actual Mulberry32 implementation and verified that two generators initialized with seed 40731 produced identical 20-value sequences.

checks.name: Offline runtime references

summary: A polished, self-contained Canvas 2D bioluminescent ecosystem with seeded blooms, drifters, hunters, propagating signals, energy transfer, birth and depletion, three presets, responsive controls, and accessible reduced-motion support.
